Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active strikes/sirens: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian targets continue. Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas missile/rocket strikes against Israel continue daily.
  • Pause announced: Trump announced a SECOND pause on energy-targeted strikes — 10 days (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), said at Iran's request and that talks are "going very well." Iran denies direct talks.
  • Violation history: First 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Diplomacy: Indirect US–Iran technical talks in Doha reported as progressing. Pakistan acting as mediator. Further negotiations expected after Khamenei funeral.
  • Northern Border (Hezbollah): Daily activity. Persistent rocket/missile exchanges and skirmishes along Lebanon-Israel line.
  • Air/Sea picture: Regional airports partly closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Flight scans show increased military airlift (RCH, C130, charters). Iran allowing Hormuz transit for Russia, India, China while blocking others.
  • Military posture: US officials warn operations could resume if talks fail. Reports of ongoing US/Israeli strikes inside Iran and continuing Iranian retaliatory launches.
  • Domestic/Operational: Israeli operations in Gaza continue (IDF reports targeted strikes on Hamas commanders). US signs long-term lease to build a permanent embassy in West Jerusalem.
  • International moves: Some states maintain axis access through Hormuz; Pakistan mediating; limited troop repositioning reports (US reconsidering posture in Saudi Arabia).
  • 🟢 Good News: Technical talks aim to restart shipping; 10-day pause offers a temporary window for diplomacy; Israeli humanitarian team deployed abroad.

Bottom line:

  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
